decisions.reason: Even though it was no longer highlighted on the website, the ERP system interface plugin fits the firm's end-to-end and multichannel shop strategy, so management would be more likely to retain it than withdraw it.

Because similar price comparison tracking plugins were already pruned and this one has not appeared recently, management would likely discontinue it and reallocate resources to broader optimization and new development.

The net price reporting plugin supports analytics but seems less central to the firm's forward direction and could be absorbed into custom work or newer tools, making withdrawal slightly more likely than continuation.
